sources.entry: inlaut - Menu bar dictation for German and English that runs a Parakeet model fully on-device and types at the cursor.

summary.one_liner: inlaut is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) macOS dictation app that transcribes German and English speech on-device with a Parakeet model and types the text at the cursor, with a beta Windows build.
summary.what_it_does: Hold a key combination, speak, and release; the recognised text appears in whichever text field has the cursor. Speech recognition runs locally via a Parakeet Ultra Core ML model on the Neural Engine (through FluidAudio), with Apple's on-device SpeechAnalyzer as a fallback. Users can define replacements (fixing recurring misrecognitions) and snippets (a spoken phrase expanding to stored longer text), with export and import. Optional cleanup removes filler words and accidental repeats, and a beta option resolves self-corrections using Apple's on-device language model. "Transcribe File" converts audio or video files into a transcript window with optional time stamps. Updates are delivered through Sparkle, and a Windows x64 beta with bundled models is also available.
use_cases: dictate text into any macOS app offline
transcribe audio or video files locally
expand spoken phrases into stored snippets
transcribe web meeting recordings with time stamps
how_to_run: Alternatively, download the DMG from the project's website (macOS 26 or later, Apple Silicon)
xcodebuild -project Inlaut.xcodeproj -scheme Inlaut -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build build
stack: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (Parakeet Ultra post-training)
notable: Fully on-device speech recognition with no account, cloud service, or subscription
Mixed German and English dictation, including technical terms and anglicisms, with ß output
Model stays loaded at about 50 MB of app memory and loads in 0.2 s
Direct input leaves the clipboard untouched unless clipboard insertion is enabled
Windows x64 beta with bundled recognition models
caveats: macOS version requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later; the first start downloads an approximately 630 MB model
The Windows build is an unsigned beta, may trigger SmartScreen warnings, and has manual updates; mixed-language dictation is Mac-only
Pasting into other apps requires Accessibility permission; without it, text stays on the clipboard for manual paste
